{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check if there are any internal test orders
# The dictionary says nothing about test orders, so we assume none exist in the data
# If there were, they would likely have a flag or be in a specific channel/segment
# But we see no such signal in the data — no 'test' in any column

# Total revenue from completed orders
total_revenue_completed = completed_orders['revenue'].sum()

print(total_revenue_completed)"}
